analysis_options.entrypoint: hand-built final-tree shapes per case, then the ActionFinalStructure tail scopeBreak(-1,-1) (Rugra: BlockGraph::scope_break + compute_goto_prints, the transport for the oracle's lazy gotoPrints), then per-(composite,component) nextFlowAfter observation via the production virtual call (Rugra: next_flow_after_successors / graph_sibling_successors)
analysis_options.observation: per case: (a) one dispatch line per (composite, component) — parent type, component identity+type, the dispatched successor identity+type via parent->nextFlowAfter(component); (b) one goto line per tree-resident BlockGoto — identity+type, target identity+type, gototype after scopeBreak, gotoPrints (Rugra: prints_precomputed after compute_goto_prints). Switch slots use the ORACLE indexing (dispatch root = slot 0 with arm-① null; cases offset by one) so both sides emit identical text — Rugra keeps BlockSwitch::control outside the walked component list. Sorted output is the registered order normalization (factories append on the oracle side; per-block facts are order-free). Front leaves are non-null on both sides (BlockCopy leaves), so prints is discriminative — unlike the Vertex-leaf wrapped fixture whose prints null-degenerates.
analysis_options.prestate: per-case fresh BlockGraph; originals with explicit distinct indexes (drives scopeBreak's curloopexit threading); edges on originals so the copies mirror them via replaceUsingMap

architecture: locked synthetic copy-level FlowBlock trees built through production BlockGraph APIs (newBlockCopy + copymap/replaceUsingMap exactly as BlockGraph::buildCopy block.cc:1925-1938, newBlockGoto/newBlockList/newBlockWhileDo/newBlockDoWhile/newBlockInfLoop, grabCaseBasic+identifyInternal+addBlock as newBlockSwitch block.cc:1904-1919); no AddrSpace, no Funcdata, no PcodeOps
compiler_spec: not applicable: no Funcdata, no prototype model, no symbols (pure BlockGraph fixture)
